title: The non-spherical sup-norm problem for $\mathrm{GL}(n)$ and generalized spherical functions
summary: We solve the sup-norm problem for minimal weight vectors in an arbitrary cuspidal representation $π$ of $\mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb{Z})\backslash\mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb{R})$ with a uniform power saving bound in terms of the archimedean data of $π$, including its spectral parameters and the dimension of its minimal $K$-type. As a key ingredient, we establish new uniform decay bounds for generalized spherical functions.
